definitions.p90: nearest rank: the ceil(0.9*n)-th smallest value
definitions.model_load: load_pair(device='cuda') (tokenizer + both models from models/, local_files_only, settings applied before CUDA init) + torch.cuda.synchronize() + profile_failures() == {} and both models on GPU in eval mode; torch and transformers imports timed separately
definitions.tokenization: the production tokenizer call (add_special_tokens=False, split_special_tokens=True, offsets) alone
definitions.scoring: synchronize; forward_logits x2 (IDs to GPU); binoculars_statistics (float32 log-softmax, full-vocabulary reductions, validation guards, scalars to host); synchronize
definitions.end_to_end: BinocularsAnalyzer(text) with the loaded pair, between two synchronize calls: tokenization, settings re-read, scoring, OriginEvidence assembly (includes hashing the 7 source files for scoring_config); excludes model load and input file I/O
definitions.memory: torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats() before each length block; max_memory_allocated / max_memory_reserved after it
definitions.offline: each length block runs under litmus.offline.offline_guards()
